nodes.label: Autoencoder-Based Data Quality Management
nodes.rationale: Train autoencoder on ILI component vectors. Flag data as SUSPECT_ANOMALY when reconstruction MSE exceeds learned threshold (3x training MSE). Two-layer framework: autoencoder for sudden anomalies + drift-diffusion for gradual parameter shift.

nodes.label: Stochastic Drift and Hitting-Time Framework
nodes.rationale: Ito diffusion model dXt = mu(t,Xt)dt + sigma(t,Xt)dWt for volatility forecasting beyond GARCH. Barrier hitting-time statistics for strategy robustness evaluation during liquidity stress events.
